approach: Static recompilation of the PowerPC executable and its relocatable modules to C, linked against a runtime that stands in for the GameCube hardware
notes: Boots, saves and plays mission 1 at 60 fps with sound and controller support on Windows. Widescreen, 120 fps, an in-game options menu and a build-from-your-disc launcher are in progress. No packaged release yet: build from source with your own disc.
